title: That’s Bad Advice
description: Dr. Sarah Boston, DVM, DVSc, DACVS-SA, joins Dr. Andy Roark for a hilarious and surprisingly thoughtful conversation about the worst advice they’ve heard in veterinary medicine. From “if you love what you do, you’ll never work a day in your life” to “just let them simmer” when clients are upset, they unpack the well-intentioned wisdom...
